name: A new CoA-class character starts with its seeded action bar (#5272)
contract: playercreateinfo_action seeds a Human Ranger (race 1, class 21) with Attack 6603 in button 0 and its starting spells 500074, 800083 and 802036 in buttons 1-3. Player::Create adds those buttons before OnPlayerCreateInitialItems grants the CoA live baseline, and IsActionButtonDataValid drops a spell the player does not know yet, so with the shipped PlayerStart.CustomSpells = 0 only Attack used to remain. The character is created through the normal creation handler; the bar is read after login.

steps.label: The Ranger knows its first starting spell
